description: This file defines the ZoneDescription entity class, which extends Description and maps to the ZONE_DESCRIPTION table. It includes fields for referencing a Zone object and related constructors and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: ZoneDescription
classes.description: Entity class representing a description of a zone with localization support, mapped to ZONE_DESCRIPTION table, referencing Zone and Language entities.

methods.name: ZoneDescription
methods.description: Parametrized constructor initializing zone, language, and name fields.

methods.name: getZone
methods.description: Returns the Zone associated with this description.

methods.name: setZone
methods.description: Sets the Zone associated with this description.
